description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Connect::RoutingProfile. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-resource-providers-connect

Channel.description: The channels that agents can handle in the Contact Control Panel (CCP).
Channel.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileChannelDefinition

Concurrency.description: The number of contacts an agent can have on a channel simultaneously.
Concurrency.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileConcurrencyDefinition

BehaviorType.description: Specifies the other channels that can be routed to an agent handling their current channel.
BehaviorType.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileBehaviorTypeDefinition

CrossChannelBehavior.description: Defines the cross-channel routing behavior that allows an agent working on a contact in one channel to be offered a contact from a different channel.
CrossChannelBehavior.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileCrossChannelBehaviorDefinition

MediaConcurrency.description: Contains information about which channels are supported, and how many contacts an agent can have on a channel simultaneously.
MediaConcurrency.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileMediaConcurrencyDefinition

Delay.description: The delay, in seconds, a contact should wait in the queue before they are routed to an available agent.
Delay.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileDelayDefinition

Priority.description: The order in which contacts are to be handled for the queue.
Priority.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfilePriorityDefinition

QueueArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the queue.
QueueArn.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileQueueArnDefinition

RoutingProfileQueueReference.description: Contains the channel and queue identifier for a routing profile.
RoutingProfileQueueReference.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileRoutingProfileQueueReferenceDefinition

RoutingProfileQueueConfig.description: Contains information about the queue and channel for which priority and delay can be set.
RoutingProfileQueueConfig.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileRoutingProfileQueueConfigDefinition

RoutingProfileManualAssignmentQueueConfi.description: Contains information about the manual assignment queue and channel
RoutingProfileManualAssignmentQueueConfi.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileRoutingProfileManualAssignmentQueueConfigDefinition

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Tag.title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileTagDefinition

InstanceArn.description: The identifier of the Amazon Connect instance.

Name.description: The name of the routing profile.

Description.description: The description of the routing profile.

MediaConcurrencies.description: The channels agents can handle in the Contact Control Panel (CCP) for this routing profile.

DefaultOutboundQueueArn.description: The identifier of the default outbound queue for this routing profile.

QueueConfigs.description: The queues to associate with this routing profile.

ManualAssignmentQueueConfigs.description: The manual assignment queues to associate with this routing profile.

Tags.description: An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource.

AgentAvailabilityTimer.description: Whether agents with this routing profile will have their routing order calculated based on longest idle time or time since their last inbound contact.

title: AWSConnectRoutingProfileProperties
